good: Slow. Stop on the sore spots and breathe there for a few seconds
Cross the other leg on top if you want more pressure
Start at the ankle and work up, not the other way
bad: Rolling back and forth fast like you are sawing wood
Holding your breath on the tender spots

good: Face down, one thigh on the roller, slow from knee to hip
Bend and straighten the knee while you pause on a spot
Sit on the roller, cross one ankle over the opposite knee, lean into that side
Small movements. You are hunting one spot, not covering ground
This is the one most players skip and most need
bad: Sitting on it and not actually loading one side

good: Roller across the upper back, hands behind the head, ribs down
Pause and breathe into each level before moving up
Stay above the bottom of the ribcage. The lower back does not get rolled
bad: Letting the ribs flare and arching over the roller

good: On your side, arm overhead, roller under the armpit and down the side of the back
Your serving side will be the worse one. Give it the time
Knees wide, hips back to the heels, arms long
Breathe into your back and let it widen
bad: Rushing to the breathing before the body has settled

good: In for four, hold four, out for four, hold four
Lie down, one hand on the belly. Only that hand should move
This is the part that actually switches you off. Do not cut it short
bad: Straining to hold the counts. Shorten to three if four is a fight
Doing it with your phone in your other hand
